name: Organic Producers Fair
description: Before the festival music starts, visit the organic market in the same park for fresh bread, honey, fruit, and other local bio products.
longDescription:
The Organic Producers Fair is a market event dedicated to locally sourced, certified organic products. Taking place at Parque da Cidade, this fair provides a platform for regional farmers and artisans to directly offer their goods to the public. It serves as an opportunity to connect consumers with the origins of their food and support sustainable agricultural practices within the Porto region.

Visitors to the fair can expect a relaxed outdoor atmosphere, suitable for browsing a variety of stalls. Offerings typically include freshly baked goods, various types of honey, seasonal fruits and vegetables, and other bio-certified food items. The event is designed for a general audience interested in healthy eating and supporting local producers.

Entry to the Organic Producers Fair is free, and walk-ins are welcome. The Parque da Cidade is accessible via multiple bus lines, with stops located around the park's perimeter. The event is family-friendly, offering an open-air environment for all ages.
